description: Partial request-pattern mitigation. Rejects traversal markers in the query-routed WordPress pagename template selector.
affected_versions: WordPress WordPress: 0 to <7.1.2; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects traversal markers in the query-routed WordPress pagename template selector.
limitations: Only the query-routed pagename form is matched. Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Page slugs containing literal or percent-encoded double dots are blocked.
